errors.evidence: The y-axis label is not provided in the figure, and the description incorrectly assigns '搭配组数标准差' as the y-axis label.

The first line (blue solid line) has no markers, but the description claims it has circular markers.
The blue solid line reaches approximately 50 in 1950, but the peak is stated to occur in 1952-1954 in the atom checklist, and the value in 1950 is not the peak.
The peak value of the blue solid line in 1954 is slightly below 70, not 65.
The blue dashed line starts at 0 in 1946, not 5.
The blue dashed line ends at approximately 0 in 2018, not slightly below 0.
The description does not clearly state the purpose of the chart as showing the change of a certain indicator over time from 1946 to 2018.
The description omits the detailed pattern of multiple peaks in the blue solid line between 1960 and 1980.
